It is located in the village of Ereste in Mulgi Parish, Viljandi County, just west of Õisu. The lake and its surroundings are covered by the Õisu Landscape Conservation Area.


== Physical description ==
The lake has an area of 190.9 hectares (472 acres). The lake has an average depth of 2.8 meters (9 ft 2 in) and a maximum depth of 4.3 meters (14 ft). It is 2,300 meters (7,500 ft) long, and its shoreline measures 6,920 meters (22,700 ft). It has a volume of 5,252,000 cubic meters (185,500,000 cu ft).
